article.title: Fain accepts Debs Award, calls for May Day ’28 general strike
article.author: Editor
article.content: United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain accepted the 2026 Eugene V. Debs Award on Nov. 21 before a crowd of union members, retirees, and activists at the Terre Haute Convention Center. “We never win by playing it safe,” Fain told them. The post Fain accepts Debs Award, calls for May Day ’28 general strike appeared first on MR Online .
